analysis: post-hoc design-based uncertainty added to the completed fixed-sample relevance sensitivity
sampling_design: original eight strata; 16 queries sampled without replacement within each stratum; query is sampling unit
estimand: finite-frame mean of query-level lower and upper paired RR contrasts under each reviewer-specific expanded-relevance rule

method_and_limits.interval: Primary: one-sided exact hypergeometric CDF count limits with Bonferroni over both endpoints, all strata and complete fixed-support thresholds. Secondary: Neyman variance and Welch-Satterthwaite t approximation.
method_and_limits.exactness: primary finite-sample coverage is conservative under the original within-stratum SRSWOR/pseudorandom-hash interpretation; t coverage is approximate and potentially unstable with sparse nonzero observations
method_and_limits.scope: finite H8530 frame and this fixed post-hoc relevance rule; no generalization beyond the frame
method_and_limits.four_combination_family: Additional simultaneous95 bounds for RIDGE_verified RR@3, A/B by relevance thresholds 1/2; each combination uses alpha=.05/4

exact_conservative_envelope.coverage_scope: both finite-frame identification endpoints within this reviewer/threshold/cutoff/policy combination
